# scoop-boot package list for the WSL Debian distribution (delivered by
# scoop-boot.ps1 --update; do not edit). One apt package per line; "#" starts a
# comment. --wsl-setup installs the packages that are missing, with
# --no-install-recommends. To change the list on one machine, copy this file to
# etc\packages\<hostname>.debian.txt (lower case host name): it replaces this file
# completely and is never touched by --update.
# Claude Code is not an apt package: --wsl-setup installs it with the official
# installer after the list (skip with --no-claude).

# Base system and certificates
ca-certificates
curl
wget
gnupg
unzip
zip
xz-utils
locales
sudo

# Build tools
build-essential
make
cmake
ninja-build
pkg-config

# Version control
git
git-lfs
openssh-client

# Languages
python3
python3-venv
python3-pip
pipx
default-jdk-headless
maven

# Command line tools
jq
ripgrep
fd-find
bat
less
tree
htop
tmux

shellcheck
